regmap.name: ID
regmap.description: Identification and version. Read-only constants, so a correct read here proves the AXI4-Lite path reaches this block before any other register is trusted.

bitfields.name: MAGIC
bitfields.description: Always 0x4D58 (ASCII 'MX'). A read of 0x0000 or 0xFFFF means the bus is not reaching the mixer.

bitfields.name: VER_MAJOR
bitfields.description: Major version. Increment on any incompatible map change.

bitfields.name: VER_MINOR
bitfields.description: Minor version. Increment on backwards-compatible additions.

regmap.name: CAPS
regmap.description: Build-time capabilities, so software can size its own layer loops from the hardware it is actually talking to instead of from a compile-time assumption. These are constants baked into the map by gen_regs.py; axis_video_mixer.sv asserts at elaboration that they match the RTL parameters, so a map and a build that disagree fail loudly rather than misreporting.

bitfields.name: NUM_LAYERS
bitfields.description: Number of layer input streams this build instantiates.

bitfields.name: FIFO_DEPTH_LOG2
bitfields.description: Per-layer input FIFO depth, as a power of two. A layer wider than 2**this cannot be guaranteed free of underflow.

bitfields.name: OUT_HAS_ALPHA
bitfields.description: 1 if the output stream carries RGBA8 (32-bit TDATA), 0 if it carries RGB8 (24-bit TDATA) with alpha discarded after blending.

regmap.name: SCRATCH
regmap.description: Read/write scratchpad with no hardware effect. Exists so a write-then-read test can prove the bus end to end without disturbing the picture.

bitfields.name: VALUE
bitfields.description: Any value. Reads back exactly what was written.

regmap.name: CTRL
regmap.description: Global mixer control.

bitfields.name: EN
bitfields.description: Enable the output stream. While 0 the mixer holds TVALID low and accepts and discards nothing -- layer inputs are backpressured. Set the canvas and layer geometry first, then set this.

bitfields.name: SOFT_RST
bitfields.description: Write 1 to resynchronise the whole datapath: flush every layer FIFO, drop to the top of a new output frame, and re-arm each layer at its next input SOF. Self-clearing; does not touch configuration registers.

regmap.name: CANVAS
regmap.description: Output raster size in pixels. The mixer emits HEIGHT lines of WIDTH pixels per frame. Changing either takes effect at the next output frame boundary.

bitfields.name: WIDTH
bitfields.description: Output active width in pixels. Must be non-zero.

bitfields.name: HEIGHT
bitfields.description: Output active height in lines. Must be non-zero.

regmap.name: BACKGROUND
regmap.description: Colour of the canvas underneath every layer. This is what shows through wherever no enabled layer covers a pixel, which is why no layer is obliged to span the whole canvas -- every input can be an arbitrary rectangle.

bitfields.name: RGB
bitfields.description: Background colour, {R[23:16], G[15:8], B[7:0]}.

regmap.name: STATUS
regmap.description: Live state. Read-only and never latched -- these reflect the current cycle, unlike the ERR register which latches.

bitfields.name: ERR_ANY
bitfields.description: 1 while any bit in ERR is set. Lets a polling loop check one register instead of two.

bitfields.name: FRAME_ACTIVE
bitfields.description: 1 while the output is mid-frame (between SOF and the last pixel of the last line).

bitfields.name: LAYER_ARMED
bitfields.description: One bit per layer: 1 once that layer has seen its input SOF and is delivering pixels. A layer that stays 0 is not receiving a stream.

regmap.name: FRAME_COUNT
regmap.description: Output frames completed since reset. Incrementing proves the pipeline is running; a stuck value with EN set means the output is stalled or a layer is starving.

bitfields.name: COUNT
bitfields.description: Free-running, wraps at 2**32.

regmap.name: ERR
regmap.description: Latched error flags. Hardware sets, software clears by writing 1 to the bit. Latched rather than live because every one of these is a transient that would otherwise be missed between two polls.

bitfields.name: CFG
bitfields.description: Configuration rejected: canvas width or height is zero, or an enabled layer's window is zero-sized or extends past the canvas edge. The offending layer is flagged in ERR_LAYER; a canvas fault sets this bit alone. The mixer keeps running on the last valid configuration.

bitfields.name: STARVE
bitfields.description: A layer's input FIFO ran empty at a pixel where that layer was due to contribute. The layer is dropped for the remainder of the frame and re-arms at its next input SOF; the output never stalls.

bitfields.name: GEOM
bitfields.description: A layer's stream geometry disagreed with its SIZE register -- TLAST arrived somewhere other than the configured last pixel of a line, or TUSER somewhere other than the first pixel of a frame. That layer resynchronises at its next input SOF.

bitfields.name: SRC_STALL
bitfields.description: A layer input was held backpressured -- TVALID high, TREADY low because its FIFO was full -- for longer than STALL_LIMIT cycles. The mirror image of OUT_STALL: that source is producing faster than the mixer consumes, which in practice means a frame rate mismatch. Harmless in short bursts, which is why it is measured against a threshold rather than flagged on the first stalled cycle.

bitfields.name: OUT_STALL
bitfields.description: The downstream sink held TREADY low for longer than the stall threshold while the mixer had a beat to give. Distinguishes 'the display pipeline is blocked' from 'a source is starving', which look identical from a stuck FRAME_COUNT alone.

regmap.name: ERR_LAYER
regmap.description: One latched bit per layer, set alongside the per-layer causes in ERR. Names which input is at fault without having to read every layer's status register. Write 1 to a bit to clear that layer alone.

bitfields.name: L0
bitfields.description: Layer 0 has latched a starve, geometry or overflow fault.

bitfields.name: L1
bitfields.description: Layer 1 has latched a starve, geometry or overflow fault.

bitfields.name: L2
bitfields.description: Layer 2 has latched a starve, geometry or overflow fault.

bitfields.name: L3
bitfields.description: Layer 3 has latched a starve, geometry or overflow fault.

regmap.name: IRQ_EN
regmap.description: Interrupt enable, one bit per ERR bit and in the same order. The irq output is the OR of (ERR & IRQ_EN), so it stays asserted until software clears the ERR bit.

bitfields.name: CFG
bitfields.description: Enable interrupt on ERR.CFG.

bitfields.name: STARVE
bitfields.description: Enable interrupt on ERR.STARVE.

bitfields.name: GEOM
bitfields.description: Enable interrupt on ERR.GEOM.

bitfields.name: SRC_STALL
bitfields.description: Enable interrupt on ERR.SRC_STALL.

bitfields.name: OUT_STALL
bitfields.description: Enable interrupt on ERR.OUT_STALL.

regmap.name: STALL_LIMIT
regmap.description: How long a stream may stay stalled before ERR.OUT_STALL or ERR.SRC_STALL latches, in clock cycles. Applies to both directions: the downstream sink holding TREADY low, and a layer source held backpressured on a full FIFO. Reset is 0x10000 -- comfortably longer than any legitimate gap, comfortably shorter than a frame.

bitfields.name: CYCLES
bitfields.description: 0 disables the check.

regmap.name: L0_CTRL
regmap.description: Layer 0 enable and alpha. Takes effect at the next output frame boundary.

bitfields.name: EN
bitfields.description: Enable this layer. Layer 0. Layers composite bottom-up in port order, so layer 0 is nearest the background and the highest-numbered enabled layer is on top.

bitfields.name: ALPHA
bitfields.description: Global alpha, 0 transparent to 255 opaque. Multiplied into each pixel's own alpha unless ALPHA_SRC selects otherwise.

bitfields.name: ALPHA_SRC
bitfields.description: Where this layer's alpha comes from.

enums.name: PIXEL_X_GLOBAL
enums.description: Per-pixel alpha from TDATA multiplied by ALPHA. The usual choice.

enums.name: GLOBAL_ONLY
enums.description: Ignore the pixel's alpha channel and use ALPHA alone. Use for a source that leaves its alpha byte undefined.

regmap.name: L0_POS
regmap.description: Layer 0 top-left corner, in canvas pixels. Takes effect at the next output frame boundary, so a moving window never tears.

bitfields.name: X
bitfields.description: Left edge, 0 is the leftmost canvas pixel.

bitfields.name: Y
bitfields.description: Top edge, 0 is the topmost canvas line.

regmap.name: L0_SIZE
regmap.description: Layer 0 size, in pixels. The mixer does not scale: this must match the geometry the input stream actually delivers, or ERR.GEOM latches and the layer is dropped.

bitfields.name: WIDTH
bitfields.description: Width in pixels. Must be non-zero and X+WIDTH must not exceed the canvas width.

bitfields.name: HEIGHT
bitfields.description: Height in lines. Must be non-zero and Y+HEIGHT must not exceed the canvas height.

regmap.name: L0_STATUS
regmap.description: Layer 0 live state. Read-only, not latched -- for the latched history see ERR and ERR_LAYER.

bitfields.name: ARMED
bitfields.description: 1 once the layer has seen its input SOF and is streaming.

bitfields.name: DROPPED
bitfields.description: 1 while the layer is being skipped for the rest of the current frame, after a starve or geometry fault.

bitfields.name: CFG_BAD
bitfields.description: 1 while this layer's window is rejected as out of bounds or zero-sized. The layer contributes nothing while this is set.

bitfields.name: FIFO_LEVEL
bitfields.description: Current occupancy of this layer's input FIFO, in pixels. A level pinned at 0 means the source is too slow; pinned at full means the source is ahead and being backpressured, which is healthy.
